subject: Request: KMS rotation proof + portal syslog evidence for profile update
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Acme Security <sec-eng@acme.com>
Cc: portal-support@vendr.com
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: KMS rotation proof + portal syslog evidence for profile update

Hi team —

Thanks again for starting the vendor portal onboarding. To finish the security profile verification on Vendr and update our internal SIG/CAIQ mappings we need two items from Acme: a formal proof of the most recent KMS (customer master key) rotation and a short syslog/sample metadata file that shows automated aggregation of authentication events over the last 30 days.

Specifically, can you provide: 
- A signed/hashed rotation audit (PDF) with key IDs, rotation timestamps, and the audit authority or KMS ARN that performed the rotation.
- A small syslog metadata CSV (example headers in-line below) that proves logs are being forwarded to your aggregator (no PII or raw logs please).

Example CSV headers we can accept: event_time, host, service, event_type, forwarding_endpoint

If it's easier, an S3 object link (time-limited) or a secure upload to the Vendr portal is fine — just call out the URL. We're aiming to have this in the portal by next week so our compliance team can validate the SIG control references.

Cc'ing Grace from security ops and Rishi from compliance for intake and redaction guidance.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none (please attach your artifacts in reply)
From: Acme Security <sec-eng@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 12:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: KMS rotation proof + portal syslog evidence for profile update

Ben —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide both items. Planned deliverables: one PDF export from our KMS audit that includes rotation entries (we'll redact internal operator IDs), and a metadata CSV showing the syslog forwarding to our central aggregator (no payloads).

Two quick notes:
1) For the KMS audit we typically providethe ARN and rotation timestamp; we will also include a SHA256 hash of the exported file for provenance.
2) For the syslog metadata, we will exclude any IP addresses and any user-level identifiers. If Redwood needs IP-level detail for verification we can provide a hashed token mapping under an NDA — let me know.

We'll upload artifacts to the S3 share link you provided and also add them to the Vendr portal entry. Expect the upload by Monday 2027-03-08.

Regards,
Marcus Lee
Security Engineering Manager
Acme Corp
Attachments: kms-rotation-audit-20270301.pdf (attached), syslog-metadata-aggregate-20270228.csv (attached)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: KMS rotation proof + portal syslog evidence for profile update

Grace / Rishi —

Forwarding Acme's artifacts. They uploaded the two files and left a short S3 invite (below). Can you:
- Quick check for any identifiers we need to redact before we push to Vendr (Grace).
- Confirm the SIG control mapping lines that should reference the KMS rotation proof (Rishi).

S3 link (time-limited): https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/acme-evidence/rotation/2027-03-01?k=read (expires 2027-03-15)

If everything looks good I'll submit on Vendr and mark the profile as verified.

Ben

Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: KMS rotation proof + portal syslog evidence for profile update

Ben / Grace —

Thanks for the review. We toggled the operator IDs to pseudonyms and removed raw IPs from the CSV as requested. Confirmed items uploaded: kms-rotation-audit-20270301.pdf, syslog-metadata-aggregate-20270228.csv, and a short s3-share-invite-acme-portal.txt with the pre-signed link.

Portal-support, please confirm receipt in Vendr and that the files are attached to the Acme profile. If you need any additional attestations (hashes, notarization), let us know and we'll escalate.

Best,
Marcus Lee
Security Engineering Manager
Acme Corp
